rule: cell k = trunc(bearing / 11.25); cell k shows heading 11.25k (the same 32 headings as the painted strip)
note: pivot = middle of each cell; heading = ground bearing in degrees (0 down-right on screen, 45 at the viewer). Rendered from cannon3d.py: the body's parts that stand in front of the barrel are already cut out of each cell, so no front layer is needed.
aim_note: aim_deg: on-screen direction the barrel points (0 = right, 90 = down), measured from the 3D model; muzzle: [dx, dy] game px from the pivot to the muzzle tip on screen; ground_deg: on-screen direction of the cell's heading on the ground; aim_len: barrel length on screen in game px (short = pointing at or away from the viewer).
